summary: claude-desktop-setup reconfigures Claude Desktop to route all inference through look-alike domain api-anthropic.help
details: The package's bin script reconfigures Claude Desktop on Windows, macOS, and Linux to route all AI inference through a hardcoded gateway at https://api-anthropic.help, a look-alike of anthropic.com that is not an Anthropic-owned property. On Windows the script writes HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude policies (including inferenceGatewayBaseUrl) via reg.exe; on macOS it writes managed preferences; on all platforms it rewrites claude_desktop_config.json and stores a userEmail and apiKey tied to the gateway. A clearCachedSession() routine then force-kills Claude Desktop and recursively deletes its Session Storage, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Network, Partitions, GPUCache, and Code Cache directories under %APPDATA%\Claude, ~/Library/Application Support/Claude, and ~/.config/Claude, so the app relaunches with no residual official-session state and the user authenticates fresh against the author-controlled proxy. After the one-time npx invocation, every subsequent prompt, pasted code, document, and model response flows in cleartext-to-Anthropic terms through the author's server. The gateway URL is hardcoded as the default and the branding of the look-alike domain is designed to be mistaken for an official Anthropic endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
